北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，晴好但体感 -13℃，注意防寒保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, clear but feels like -13℃, stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阵雨并有 4 级风，体感 2℃，出行记得带伞添衣！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has showers and 4-level wind, feels like 2℃. Take an umbrella and dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 2℃，微凉，记得多穿件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 2℃. A bit chilly, remember to wear an extra coat!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州大雾，湿度 96%，注意行车安全和防潮哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy with 96% humidity. Drive safely and be mindful of dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温 15℃ 适宜，但湿度高，依然要注意。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 15℃ feels nice, but high humidity. Still be aware!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雨夹雪，体感 -1℃，路面湿滑，注意保暖和安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has sleet, feels like -1℃. Roads are slippery, stay warm and safe!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雨夹雪，体感 -2℃，湿度 100%，出门小心湿滑！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has sleet, feels like -2℃, 100% humidity. Be careful of slippery roads!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 4℃，略有凉意，记得多添一件衣裳。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 4℃. A bit cool, remember to add a layer.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 -2℃，风力 3 级，多穿些暖和的衣服哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like -2℃ with 3-level wind. Wear more warm clothes.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 -4℃，湿度 100%，地面湿滑，注意防寒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like -4℃, 100% humidity. Slippery ground, stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃，出门记得带件外套，小心着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 8℃. Remember a coat when out, don't catch a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -30℃！极寒天气，务必厚厚保暖，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -30℃! Extremely cold, bundle up warmly and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -30℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，但体感 -25℃，出门千万别忘了多穿衣服哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, but feels like -25℃. Don't forget to bundle up when out!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，体感 2℃，湿度 90%，温差大注意保暖！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear, feels like 2℃, 90% humidity. Big temperature difference, stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云有 4 级风，体感 10℃，海边风大，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with 4-level wind, feels like 10℃. Windy by the sea, watch out.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 -8℃，风力 3 级，海风凛冽，注意防寒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -8℃ with 3-level wind. Sea wind is biting, stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -10℃，风力 3 级，海风寒冷，务必保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -10℃ with 3-level wind. Sea wind is cold, stay very warm!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
